zh_CN: 本波战斗金币 %d；每 200 金币附加 1，最多为基础、波次和购买次数合计的 10%%。
en: Combat gold this wave: %d. Each 200 gold adds 1, capped at 10%% of the combined base, wave and purchase costs.

zh_CN:
理智达到100时按原有价格交易、获得全额利息；低于0后代价继续增加。
购买修正包含武器、升级和遗物；出售修正包含武器和附魔。
en:
At 100 Sanity, trade at normal prices and receive full interest. Costs keep rising below 0.
Purchase adjustments apply to weapons, upgrades and relics; sale adjustments apply to weapons and enchantments.

zh_CN: 理智 %s：购买价格 +%s%%，出售收益 −%s%%，利息收益 −%s%%。
en: Sanity %s: purchase prices +%s%%, sale proceeds −%s%%, interest income −%s%%.

zh_CN: 通过曲线函数换算为受到伤害百分比；正护甲减伤，负护甲增伤。
en: Converted to damage taken through an armor curve. Positive armor reduces damage; negative armor increases it.

zh_CN: 影响武器的攻击距离与索敌距离。
en: Affects weapon reach and targeting range.

zh_CN: 正攻速冷却倍率 = 1 / (1 + log2(1 + attack_speed / 100) / 3)。100 点保留 75% 冷却，300 点保留 60%。负攻速沿用 1 / (1 + attack_speed / 300)。不加快武器动作与喷射频率。
en: Positive attack speed: cooldown multiplier = 1 / (1 + log2(1 + attack_speed / 100) / 3). At 100, cooldown is 75%; at 300, 60%. Negative attack speed uses 1 / (1 + attack_speed / 300). Does not speed up attack animations or spray ticks.

zh_CN: 所有软控、硬控持续时间乘以（1 + 控制强度 / 100），再受敌人控制抗性修正；保留雷电连锁目标数加成。
en: Multiplies all soft and hard crowd-control durations by (1 + Control Strength / 100), before enemy resistance. Retains the bonus to lightning chain targets.
Chance for an attack to critically hit.

zh_CN: 暴击时的伤害百分比，150表示造成150%伤害。
en: Damage percentage on a critical hit. 150 means 150% damage.

zh_CN: 拾取金币的百分比加成，不直接加成利息、固定交易奖励或最终营地币。
en: Percentage bonus to gold pickups. Does not directly increase interest, fixed trade rewards, or final Camp Coins.

zh_CN: 影响适用攻击的伤害半径或宽度，并同步对应视觉大小。
en: Affects the radius or width of supported attacks and their visual size.

zh_CN: 通用伤害百分比加成，影响近战、远程和元素武器伤害。
en: General percentage damage bonus affecting melee, ranged and elemental weapons.

zh_CN: 最终承受伤害百分比，整数100表示承受100%伤害，89表示承受89%伤害。
en: Final percentage of incoming damage taken. 100 means 100% damage; 89 means 89%.

zh_CN: 波初读取侵蚀度，增强怪物属性并增加精英配额；普通刷怪数量乘以（1 + 非负侵蚀度 / 100），小数余量跨批累计，不改变刷新间隔。
en: Snapshots Corruption at wave start to strengthen enemies and raise the elite quota. Regular spawn counts are multiplied by (1 + nonnegative Corruption / 100), carrying fractional remainders between batches without changing spawn intervals.

zh_CN: 局内掉落概率加成。附魔采用递减收益：正加成最多提高40%，负加成最多降低75%；其余掉落仍按百分比计算。
en: Bonus to drop chances. Enchantment drops have diminishing returns: positive bonuses increase the rate by up to 40%; negative bonuses reduce it by up to 75%. Other drops use percentage scaling.

zh_CN: 元素武器、元素附魔及元素反应造成的固定伤害加成。
en: Flat damage bonus for elemental weapons, enchantments and reactions.

zh_CN: 每次刷怪的数量增幅；20 表示每组生成数量增加 20%。
en: Percentage increase in enemies per spawn group. 20 means 20% more.

zh_CN: 血包拾取后的固定生命恢复量加成，可为负，不影响血包掉落概率。
en: Flat bonus to health restored by pickups. Can be negative; does not affect their drop chance.

zh_CN: 每秒恢复的生命值；负值会抵扣正向回血，战斗结算时以 0 为下限（不会掉血），面板仍显示真实数值。
en: Health restored each second. Negative values offset positive regeneration; the combat result is floored at 0, so this cannot drain HP. The panel shows the actual stat.

zh_CN: 理智初始为100，不设上下限。低于100时购买更贵、出售收益和利息降低；达到100时按原有价格和全额利息结算。
en: Sanity starts at 100 and has no upper or lower bound. Below 100, purchases cost more and sale proceeds and interest decrease. At 100, prices and interest are normal.

zh_CN: 当前有效利率，默认 5；支持小数成长。名义利息为 ceil(本金×利率/100)，再受理智修正；实际利息加入随身金币，不自动增加本金。
en: Current effective interest rate, starting at 5. Supports fractional growth. Nominal interest is ceil(principal × rate / 100), then adjusted by Sanity. Interest goes to carried gold, not automatically to principal.

zh_CN: 每次击杀敌人后恢复的固定生命值。
en: Flat health restored per enemy killed.

zh_CN: 玩家可装备武器的总负载上限。
en: Maximum combined load of equipped weapons.

zh_CN: 影响稀有遗物与升级选项；附魔掉率随幸运递减增长，最多相对提高60%。每波每掉1个附魔，普通怪后续掉率乘45%；前5波最多3个，之后4个。连续两次完成且击杀至少8个敌人的战斗未掉附魔，第二次结算补1个。
en: Affects rare relics and upgrade offers. Enchantment drop bonuses diminish with Luck, up to a relative +60%. Each enchantment drop multiplies further normal-enemy chances that wave by 45%; the cap is 3 in waves 1–5, then 4. After two completed battles with at least 8 kills each and no enchantment drops, the second settlement grants one.

zh_CN: 角色或敌人的最大生命值。
en: Maximum health of a character or enemy.

zh_CN: 近战伤害固定数值加成。
自动吸附经验球、奖励物的半径。
en: Radius for automatically collecting XP and reward pickups.

zh_CN: 仅影响开局初始本金；局内存取款和奖励独立修改实际本金余额。
en: Only determines starting principal. Deposits, withdrawals and rewards independently change the live principal balance.

zh_CN: 一次攻击产生的投射物数量。
en: Number of projectiles produced by one attack.

zh_CN: 远程伤害固定数值加成。
本局额外复活次数；复活后消耗 1 次。
en: Additional revives this run. One charge is consumed per revival.

zh_CN: 每波开始时的初始护盾值；波初读取当前属性，优先承受伤害。
en: Initial Shield at each wave start, read from the current stat. Absorbs damage before health.

zh_CN: 每秒恢复护盾，优先补满已有上限；溢出部分使当前护盾与上限一起增长。
en: Restores shield each second, filling existing capacity first. Excess restoration increases both current shield and capacity.

zh_CN: 共享奖励和局内商店的候选数量加成，无上限；购买货架至少 3 件，升级奖励沿用原有数量规则。
en: Additional reward and shop choices, with no upper limit. The paid shelf has at least 3 offers; level-up rewards follow their own offer rules.

zh_CN: 局内商店价格折扣；10 表示商店价格降低 10%，负值表示涨价；多个来源逐层乘算叠加。
en: Shop price discount. 10 means prices are 10% lower; negative values raise prices. Multiple sources multiply sequentially.
